Description: Rate at which a person becomes infected, λ(t), assumed to be proportional to the number of infectious people (I1 + I2) and the constant transmission rate β.
Transition from the first to the second exposed compartment at a daily rate σ.
Transition from the second exposed compartment to the first infectious compartment at a daily rate σ.
Transition from the first to the second infectious compartment at a daily rate γ.
Transition from the second infectious compartment to the recovered compartment at a daily rate γ.

Name: σ
Description: Daily rate of transition from E1 to E2 and from E2 to I1.

Name: γ
Description: Daily rate of transition from I1 to I2 and from I2 to R.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate (the rate at which new infections take place given a contact).
